item.title: Catalog Discovery: build a reliable software catalog with Port AI
item.description: We just launched Catalog Discovery. It cuts catalog-building time from weeks to minutes by analyzing your SDLC ecosystem and surfacing the entities and relationships teams usually map by hand. A complete, accurate catalog is the system of record for any human or AI that needs to act on your system. Catalog Discovery brings the catalog to that level from day one.
